findings.evidence: Proof 1.1 extends the given columns of Q-hat to an orthogonal basis, but the theorem hypotheses and named dependencies establish only Q-hat^T Q-hat = I. The [FNC QR chapter, §3.3.2](https://fncbook.com/qr/), lines 154–189, gives a full QR factorization and forms a thin factor from that chosen full factor; it does not establish completion for every reduced factorization in the theorem statement. A Gram–Schmidt completion argument or a direct orthogonal-projection decomposition is needed. The theorem's claim is true; this is a short omitted proof step.
